name: Photo Studio
description: Take beautiful screenshots: a free camera, freeze the whole scene, pose anyone, portrait and square photos, looks, and lights.
author: Stellar

media.caption: The Photo Studio panel next to a frozen boss fight — the free camera orbits anyone you pick.
A posed group photo taken with Photo Studio.
Portrait photos are drawn in the tall shape at full detail, not cropped.

added: Take high-resolution screenshots (up to 4× your screen) with the interface hidden, and give them a look — colour, contrast, depth of field and more — saved as presets you can share.
Free camera: orbit anyone or fly around the scene, then freeze the moment — the whole game pauses on your screen, skills and effects included.
Pose anyone — you, another player or an NPC: pick an emote and the exact moment of it, a facial expression, where they look and which way they face.
Portrait, square and wide photos at full detail, with a frame guide that shows exactly what will be in the shot.
Lights: place up to 8 coloured lamps, give a person a key light from one side and a coloured rim, and choose any colour.
